taxonomy_text:
목 : 나비목 (Lepidoptera)
상과 : 명나방상과 (Pyraloidea)
과 : 명나방과 (Pyralidae)
아과 : 알락명나방아과 (Phycitinae)
속 : (Ceroprepes)

information.general_description: Winsspan 25mm. Labial palpus upturned. Antennae of male typically unipectinated. head yellowish brown. Thorax fuscous brown. Ground color of forewing light grayish brown; antemedian line black; central area between antemedian and submarginal line light gray except costal margin. Hindwing yellowish brown; female darker than male.
information.adult_male: Male genitalia. Uncus triangulated, dorsal surface of apex and lateral part covered with hairs, apical hairs stronger than lateral hairs; apical process of gnathos elongate; juxta with long and falttened lateral arms, apex pointed; valva with clasper, terminal margin of valva rounded, costa syraight; sacculus broad at base, with acutely pointed hook at apex; vinculum rounded at terminal margin. Aedeagus armed with numerous spines at end of posterior part, rather stout. Structure of VIII abdominal sternite characteristic.
information.adult_female: Apophyses posteriores longer than apophyses anteriores; ductus bursae constricted in the middle, sclerotized; corpus bursae membranous with a signum, surrounded by a cluster of numerous scobinations.
